description: Toy sandwich parts are spread out on the bed in front: two bread slices, a green plate, lettuce, cheese, tomato, onion ring, cucumber slices, and a brown patty. The left hand slides a bread slice onto the green plate, then layers lettuce and cheese, while the right hand moves in to add cucumber slices and help steady the stack; next the left hand places tomato and the right hand adds the brown patty and a pink onion ring, and finally the right hand brings the second bread slice on top and both hands press down to finish the sandwich.
